item.title: Nico Collins: Coach 'hopeful' for Week 4 return
item.description:
Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he's "hopeful" to have Collins available for the Texans' Week 4 game against the Cowboys, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Bucky Irving: Feeling fine after late exit Sunday
item.description:
Head coach Todd Bowles said that Irving won't be included on the Buccaneers' Week 4 injury report, despite missing the final two possessions of Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings, Scott Smith of the team's official site reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: A.J. Brown: Seemingly making progress with ankle
item.description:
Brown was spotted Monday in the Patriots' locker room walking without a limp and wearing a small wrap on his injured right ankle, Taylor Kyles of CLNSMedia.com reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Jalon Daniels: Will start in place of injured Mayfield
item.description:
Head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that Daniels will step in as the Buccaneers' new starting quarterback while Baker Mayfield is out for a "minimum of three weeks" due to a dislocated right thumb, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Baker Mayfield: Facing three-week absence
item.description:
Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that Mayfield (thumb) is expected to miss three weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
